title: Marking the Wrong Symptoms: Evaluating LLM Watermarks in Medical Texts
description:
arXiv:2607.20462v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into clinical workflows, stressing the need for reliable traceability of model-generated output with watermarking. Yet, most watermarks are evaluated on general-purpose benchmarks, leaving domains like medicine, where small token-level perturbations can result in significant semantic changes, underexplored.
